blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: The arctic summer is short, but intense.
exercises.ru: Арктическое лето короткое, ___ насыщенное.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Mary was born in Australia, but is a Dutch citizen.
exercises.ru: Мэри родилась в Австралии, ___ является подданной Нидерландов.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I am Christian, but he is Buddhist.
exercises.ru: Я христианин, ___ вот он буддист.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This is a hotel, not a brothel.
exercises.ru: Это отель, ___ не бордель.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Let it be survival of the fittest, but quickly and carefully directed.
exercises.ru: Пусть это будет естественный отбор, ___ ускоренно и заботливо направляемый.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: And then, what did you do?
exercises.ru: ___ потом что ты сделал?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The horse does the work and the coachman is tipped.
exercises.ru: Лошадь везет, ___ извозчику - деньги.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She designs her clothes and then has a seamstress make them.
exercises.ru: Она создаёт свою одежду, ___ затем швея шьет её.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You have a St. Petersburg accent, but an Odessan sense of humor.
exercises.ru: У тебя санкт-петербургский акцент, ___ одесское чувство юмора.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Christopher Columbus once landed on the moon, but mistook it for Antarctica.
exercises.ru: Однажды Христофор Колумб высадился на Луне, ___ принял её за Антарктиду.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Education is not the learning of facts but the training of the mind to think.
exercises.ru: Образование - это не заучивание фактов, ___ тренировка мозга думать.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The conversation started with friendly banter but ended in bruises.
exercises.ru: Разговор начался с добродушных подшучиваний, ___ закончился синяками.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The salaryman proposed to the director's daughter, but he was rejected.
exercises.ru: Саларимен предложил дочери директора выйти за него замуж, ___ получил отказ.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Ikeda is my last name, and Kazuko is my first name.
exercises.ru: Моя фамилия - Икеда, ___ имя - Кадзуко.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom won the lottery, but went bankrupt a year later.
exercises.ru: Том выиграл в лотерею, ___ через год разорился.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Ted Kaczynski was not a fascist, but he inspired armies of them.
exercises.ru: Тед Качинский не был фашистом, ___ вдохновил их тысячи.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: A positron is a small particle similar to an electron, but with a positive electric charge.
exercises.ru: Позитрон - это маленькая частица, подобная электрону, ___ имеющая положительный электрический заряд.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: But your ex is a psychopath!
exercises.ru: ___ твой бывший — психопат!
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Hello, is Tom home?
exercises.ru: Здравствуйте, ___ Том дома?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You of all people should know.
exercises.ru: Кто-кто, ___ уж вы-то должны знать.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
